One small lovable creature, full body in frame, centered with breathing room around it, facing the viewer with big glossy expressive eyes. Personality you can read at a glance: {traits}. Appealing proportions with soft rounded forms, premium and stylish, never childish.

Setting: {scene}. The background is softer and slightly out of focus so the creature reads instantly.
Shot like a high-end collectible art toy campaign: soft cinematic key light, delicate rim light, subtle ground reflection, shallow depth of field, rich color, ultra detailed.
No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people, exactly one creature.

masters.note: Figure/ground contrast rule: opposite values and complementary hues, calmer background, rim light, space around the silhouette
masters.text:
{subject} as a collectible companion creature from the year 2050.
One small charming creature, the whole creature visible in frame, centered with breathing room around it, facing the viewer with big glossy expressive eyes. Personality you can read at a glance: {traits}. Appealing proportions with soft rounded forms, premium and stylish. It is clearly that animal: no horns, antlers or features borrowed from other animals, no zodiac symbols or glyphs.
Material and finish: {style}.
Color accents: {palette}.
Setting: {scene}.
Figure and ground: the creature pops off the background at a glance, even as a tiny thumbnail. Opposite values: a light creature sits against a deeper, darker part of the scene, a dark creature against a brighter one. Opposite hues: the background leans toward colors complementary to the creature's main color and is calmer, less saturated, less detailed and softly out of focus. The creature is the most brightly lit and most saturated thing in the frame, a clean rim light traces its whole silhouette, and clear space around it keeps every part from merging with background shapes.
Shot like a high-end collectible art toy campaign: soft cinematic key light, subtle ground reflection, shallow depth of field, ultra detailed.
No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people, exactly one creature.

refModes.label: Match the look
refModes.text: The attached images show the target look. Reproduce their material, surface detail, rendering technique, lighting and level of finish as closely as possible on the creature described above. Take the species, pose and setting from this prompt, not from the images.

refModes.label: Mood only
refModes.text: The attached images are mood and material inspiration only: borrow their light, palette and finish, never copy their subjects or composition.

refModes.label: Same character
refModes.text: The attached image shows this exact character. Keep its design identical: species, proportions, face, colors, materials and outfit. Change only what this prompt describes.

styles.label: Plush glow

zodiac.traits: fiery, brave, impatient, always first to act
cozy, loyal, stubborn, loves comfort and snacks
chatty, witty, curious, two moods at once
protective, sensitive, a homebody behind a hard shell
proud, dramatic, generous, loves the spotlight

elements.earth: moss green, terracotta and warm cream
elements.air: lilac, sky blue and pearl white

backdrops.light: the creature is light, so the scene around it is deep and dim: dusk shadow, darker values everywhere behind it and a dark vignette toward the edges of the frame.
backdrops.dark: the creature is dark, so the scene behind it is bright and airy: pale haze, soft high-key daylight and a luminous glow directly behind its head and body, background values much lighter than the creature.
backdrops.glow: the creature glows, so the scene around it is dark and quiet: night tones, deep shadow and only faint background detail.
backdrops.mid: the background is muted and desaturated in a hue complementary to the creature's main color, with a soft pool of brighter light directly behind it.
